size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from the endpoint, in the paginate model plugin behind GET /v1/users; the controller and service the prompt leads to only pass the options through.
prompt: GET /v1/users returns an empty `results` array even though the same response reports totalResults: 3. With ?limit=2 it returns only the last of the three users.

root_cause.detail: Off-by-one: skip is page * limit instead of (page - 1) * limit, so page 1 skips the first `limit` documents.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users > should return 200 and apply the default query options
tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users > should return the correct page if page and limit params are specified
tests/unit/models/plugins/paginate.plugin.test.js > paginate plugin > populate option > should populate the specified data fields
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js tests/unit/models/plugins/paginate.plugin.test.js -t 'should return 200 and apply the default query options|should return the correct page if page and limit params are specified|should populate the specified data fields'
